methodology.last10: exp-decayed recent form and opponent defensive normalization
methodology.comparableOpponents: verified same-league season PPG and defensive goals allowed, min 2 meaningful comparables
methodology.h2h: only prior 366 days, capped 1.5% goal mix on top of baseline
methodology.lineup: only quantitative player delta supported by dated verified sample and XI; otherwise coverage flag
methodology.possessions: passes/tackles/fouls/shots allowed affect stat projection only with verified histories
methodology.simulation: 10,000 independent goal count draws per fixture; non-goal event totals independently modeled where data exists
methodology.noDoubleCounting: factor shrinkage and small caps; goal outputs are uncalibrated; side market correlation still requires joint calibration
methodology.externalForecast: Only pre-match date-verified outcome percentages from specific public Opta Analyst articles. For each affected match, 25% of simulations draw an outcome according to the external distribution and sample a score conditionally from the original V3 Poisson score distribution; the other 75% remain independent V3 score draws. Does not imply statistical independence of forecasts.
methodology.independentEventData: V3 non-goal event forecasts preserved, no invented pass/foul/card/shots statistics
methodology.outcomeCoherence: All WDL and goal-total frequencies recomputed from the same 10,000 score draws.

limitations: 6 date-verified published external fixture forecasts; 36 other fixtures use V3-only outcome distributions.
Heuristic 25% blend has not been backtested or statistically calibrated.
Some source views show small internal forecast rounding or update discrepancies; fixture-specific article numbers are used.
Analyst reported team stats are recorded as provenance and qualitative diagnostics, not fabricated match-log xG or lineup effect.
Generated after kickoff for some fixtures; retrospective snapshots are not fair real-time previews.
